scope: Read-only performance investigation. No application edits, browser save changes, feature removals, limits, or deployment.

cpuProfile.scope: Node.js VM simulator, rendering and persistence stubbed; includes initialization and warmed workloads, not browser FPS
cpuProfile.activeWorkload: Enter 12 and 3, capture both, calculate 12 times 3; virtual time accelerated

allocationAnalysis.scope: Counts derived from instrumented networkSignals calls and verified implementation; not an allocation profiler
allocationAnalysis.workload: Calculator addition, negative subtraction, multiplication and input captures

tidyPreparation.scope: Actual anchor preparation stopped before route search using a diagnostic sentinel in an isolated VM; no model edits. VM timings are not browser Tidy completion times.

wholeCalculator.scope: Exact static loop count, not a completed routing benchmark. Full instrumented diagnostic was stopped; no application routing limit was added.

editing.scope: 20 isolated VM repetitions, not real browser localStorage throughput

currentBrowser.scope: Read-only DOM inspection of existing localhost preview, script revision 123

priorBrowserMeasurement.scope: Earlier synthetic right-button pan and wheel zoom, not rerun during this investigation and not physical device acceptance
priorBrowserMeasurement.canvasDecision: Not shipped: dense zoom improved, but dense panning was not consistently faster and control-area frame tails regressed.

recommendations: Compile reusable numeric solver workspace per topology, retaining true multi-source and displaced-buffer-driver semantics.
Track changed node and net versions; cache timer DOM references and repaint only actual changes.
Prototype tiled, cached wire rendering with original SVG editing overlay; validate sharpness, crossings, selection, and active signals before adoption.
Spatially index Tidy contacts and board obstacles; reuse geometry across retries while retaining connectivity, clearance, cancellation, and undo checks.
Use structurally shared or delta undo entries and cached unchanged project serialization, preserving existing history depth and stale-save recovery.
Consider affected-subgraph solving only after lower-risk changes, with feedback components and exact timing trace parity.
